name: grow-l-p1
description: The growth rule's first LR test at ply 1 (analyst 6.55, 11-12 ~02:00): the recipe the next global league would carry if the user takes the analyst's 6.54 six (F-L, F-P, T-P-Ne-grow, T-L-Ne-grow, optionally capped T-P-Ne and T-L-Ne) has never been played, and its trial statistic is untested on LR leaves. One factor: growing vs capped LR error tree. Lines: F-L x2; T-L-Ne capped (limit 4, threshold 1M, as error-dag-p1's tree, 46 / 55 over F-L at plies 1 / 2) x2; T-L-Ne-grow on the recommended leaf rule (grow4: --grow-mdl 0 --grow-gate age --grow-priority snapshot; W 1M, C 2, z 2, D 5M = the default, like for like with the probit series grow-p1/b/c) x2. Every line trains on chessai-grow4 (byte-identical to hybrid6 for trees and flats without growth flags; train_binary.py after create); games chessai-hybrid16; seed 49; games_per_cycle 1584 (the user's standard; 12 entries -> 12 rounds); floor 300, cap 400. Read: cold, T 0.02, one arena per ply (1, 2), v150 and the final; head to head grow vs capped, each vs F-L; plus the growth log (kept/undone trials, trial z). Predictions (6.55; ply 1 / ply 2, +-28): capped over F-L 30-60 / 20-60; grow minus capped -10..10 / -10..20; grow over F-L 25-65 at ply 1; grow 25-33 leaves by v400, 0-3 undone, kept trials at z 3-10. Nulls that pull T-L-Ne-grow from the six: grow 20+ below capped at ply 1 at the final, or fewer than 6 kept splits by v400 with trials failing the z bar (then W 2M, not a lower z). Null for the LR seats: capped within 15 of F-L.
